process.title: Six steps from shortlist to <mark class="hl">visa</mark>
process.s1.title: Pick your schools
process.s1.text: Build a list of schools with different levels of competition and check each one's requirements on the official admissions website.
process.s2.title: Know the deadlines
process.s2.text: Schools run several rounds: Early Decision (binding), Early Action (non-binding) and Regular Decision. Early rounds are in the fall, the regular round in the winter.
process.s3.title: Take the exams
process.s3.text: SAT or ACT, plus proof of English: TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo. Some schools do not require a test, but every school has its own rules.
process.s4.title: Gather the documents
process.s4.text: School grades with a translation, recommendations from teachers and a counselor, a school report. In the demo you see where each one is needed, but you upload nothing.
process.s5.title: Write the essays
process.s5.text: A Personal Statement for every school and supplements for each one separately. This is where the committee hears you as a person, not a set of grades.
process.s6.title: Money & visa
process.s6.text: Financial aid for international students (CSS Profile and school forms), then the I-20 document and the student visa.
catalog.title: Schools where every number has a <mark class="hl">source</mark>
catalog.text: For every school: deadlines, tests, essays, rules for international students and financial aid. Each value comes with a link to the official page and the date it was checked. If we could not verify it, we say so.
catalog.note: Every school in the catalog accepts first-year applications through Common App; we confirmed it on Common App's own school pages.
essay.title: We read your essay before the <mark class="hl">committee</mark> does
essay.text: Lessons on the Personal Statement and supplements, examples with our own breakdowns, and a basic check right in your browser: word count, clichés, repeated words, sentence length. Your text never leaves your page.
essay.disclaimer: Basic automated check. It does not replace human review.

pv.meta.title: Privacy · Приватность — Dossiefy
pv.meta.description: What Dossiefy stores, where, and how to delete it.
pv.p1: Dossiefy is a static site with no accounts and no forms that send data to us.
pv.store.title: What stays in your browser
pv.p2: Course progress, demo application answers and, only if you turn it on, an essay draft are saved in your browser's localStorage. We never see them.
pv.k.course: dossiefy:course:v1: lessons you marked as done and checklist ticks.
pv.k.demo: dossiefy:demo:v1: everything you type into the demo application.
pv.k.essay: dossiefy:essay-draft:v1: an essay draft, only if you tick “Keep my draft”.
pv.delete.title: How to delete it
pv.delete.text: Use “Clear my data” in the demo, “Clear progress” on the course page, “Clear” in the checker, or clear this site's data in your browser settings.
pv.p3: The essay checker runs in your browser. The text is not sent to a server.
pv.p4: We do not set cookies or use analytics or ad trackers. Fonts and libraries are served from this site.
pv.p5: Links to official school sites and Common App lead to third-party sites with their own privacy rules.
pv.p6: The paid review runs in a separate Telegram bot. What happens to your essay there is explained in the bot before you pay.
pv.p7: If you are under 18, talk to a parent about what you type into the demo.
ab.meta.title: About & disclaimer · О проекте и дисклеймер — Dossiefy
ab.meta.description: Dossiefy is an independent educational project. How we verify data and what we are not.
ab.what.title: What Dossiefy is
ab.what.text: An independent course, a demo application and a catalog for Russian-speaking students and parents.
ab.disc.title: Disclaimer
ab.disc.extra: The demo application is a simulation: nothing is sent to any school. This is not legal, immigration or admissions advice, and we promise no admission results.
ab.method.title: How we verify school data
ab.m1: We confirm on Common App's own school page that the school accepts first-year applications.
ab.m2: We take requirements only from the school's official pages.
ab.m3: Every value stores its source link, the check date and, when the page names it, the application cycle.
ab.m4: Whatever we could not confirm is marked “Needs verification”. We never fill gaps with guesses.
ab.m5: Rules change every year: always check the official site before you apply.
